name: claims-retrieval-2026-10-16
description: 论断检索评测：三篇开放获取论文（Europe PMC 全文），每篇 8 条论断（4 条英文转述、4 条中文），标注原文中能支持论断的出处句子。只评检索：召回的前 6 段是否包含出处句子。
method: 全文在评测时通过 Europe PMC REST API 按 DOI 实时获取（与产品同一条路径），不保存到仓库。论断由评测者通读全文后改写，出处句子逐字摘自全文；多处都能支持时列出多句，命中任一句即算命中（句子至少 80% 落在同一片段内）。论断都是原文确实支持的说法，用词刻意与原文不同；中文论断用来检验跨语言检索。

documents.citation: Walters, W. H., & Wilder, E. I. (2023). Fabrication and errors in the bibliographic citations generated by ChatGPT. Scientific Reports, 13, 14045.
Kung, T. H., et al. (2023). Performance of ChatGPT on USMLE: Potential for AI-assisted medical education using large language models. PLOS Digital Health, 2(2), e0000198.
Bhattacharyya, M., et al. (2023). High Rates of Fabricated and Inaccurate References in ChatGPT-Generated Medical Content. Cureus, 15(5), e39238.

cases.claim: Book chapters were the citation type that GPT-4 most often invented, at about seven in ten.
gold: Even with GPT-4, however, 70% of the cited book chapters are fabricated.

cases.claim: When ChatGPT added links to citations of genuine works, roughly a third of those links pointed to the wrong place.
gold: When links are included within the citations to real works, about one-third of them are inaccurate.

cases.claim: None of the generated papers reached the requested length of about two thousand words.
gold: Although we asked for papers of approximately 2000 words, none of the 84 papers are more than 1400 words long

cases.claim: The most frequent formatting problem in the generated references was how titles were capitalized.
gold: The most common error, by far, is improper title capitalization

cases.claim: GPT-3.5 生成的引文中，超过一半是编造的。
gold: Of the 222 works cited in the GPT-3.5 papers, 55% are fabricated
Within this set of documents, 55% of the GPT-3.5 citations but just 18% of the GPT-4 citations are fabricated.

cases.claim: 研究者检索了谷歌学术、PubMed、Scopus 和 WorldCat 等来源来判断引文是否真实存在。
gold: We then searched Google, Google Scholar, Amazon, the Directory of Open Access Journals, PubMed, Scopus, WorldCat

cases.claim: 有五篇所谓的文献综述被写成了实证研究，里面的方法和结果都是编造的。
gold: five of the “literature reviews” generated by ChatGPT are structured and presented as empirical studies, with fabricated methods and results

cases.claim: 对于较早的文献，常见的问题是写成了在线发布日期，而不是最初的出版日期。
gold: With older works, a common problem is the reporting of online posting dates rather than the original publication dates.

cases.claim: Two doctors rated each answer for accuracy, concordance and insight without seeing each other's ratings.
gold: AI outputs were independently scored for Accuracy, Concordance, and Insight (ACI) by two physician adjudicators using the criteria enumerated in S2 Data. The physicians were blinded to each other.

cases.claim: Items with pictures such as clinical photographs or graphs were dropped before the model was tested.
gold: questions containing visual assets such as clinical images, medical photography, and graphs were removed

cases.claim: The general chatbot did better than a model trained only on biomedical literature.
gold: Paradoxically, ChatGPT outperformed PubMedGPT [14] (accuracy 50.3%), a counterpart LLM with similar neural structure, but trained exclusively on biomedical domain literature.

cases.claim: Correctly answered questions came with explanations that were much richer in insight than wrongly answered ones.
gold: mean DOI was significantly higher in questions items answered accurately versus inaccurately (0.458 versus 0.199, p <0.0001)

cases.claim: ChatGPT 的答案与解释之间的总体一致性约为 95%。
gold: Overall, ChatGPT outputted answers and explanations with 94.6% concordance across all questions.

cases.claim: 大约九成的回答至少包含一条有价值的见解。
gold: Overall, ChatGPT produced at least one significant insight in 88.9% of all responses.
At least one significant insight was present in approximately 90% of outputs.

cases.claim: 在三项考试中，ChatGPT 在 Step 1 上的准确率最低。
gold: Interestingly, the accuracy of ChatGPT tended to be lowest for Step 1, followed by Step 2CK, followed by Step 3.

cases.claim: 筛选之后共有 350 道题目进入编码阶段。
gold: After filtering, 350 USMLE items (Step 1: 119, Step 2CK: 102, Step 3: 122) were advanced to encoding.

cases.claim: The detection tool judged every generated paper to be entirely machine-written.
gold: All ChatGPT-generated papers received an AI score of 100%, indicating that the AI-detection software was 100% confident that each paper was AI-generated.

cases.claim: Papers on health inequities contained a much larger share of invented references than papers on prevention.
gold: For prompt A variations, fabricated references were considerably more common (p=0.007) in papers on healthcare disparity (66%) than for prevention strategies (36%) or recent advances (34%).

cases.claim: Reference errors in the chatbot output were far more common than in published peer-reviewed articles.
gold: However, the inaccuracies identified in the references generated by ChatGPT were considerably more prevalent (93%) than those found in the peer-reviewed literature.

cases.claim: The study needed at least ninety references to have an adequate sample size.
gold: To ensure an adequate sample size, we calculated that a minimum of 90 references were needed.

cases.claim: 参考文献各要素中，出错最多的是 PMID 编号。
gold: an incorrect PMID number was most common, listed in 93% of papers

cases.claim: 两名熟悉系统综述的研究者分别在 Medline、谷歌学术和开放获取期刊目录中独立核查了参考文献。
gold: two researchers with expertise in systematic reviews independently searched Medline, Google Scholar, and the Directory of Open Access Journals

cases.claim: 受资源限制，研究没有核实论文正文内容是否准确。
gold: we did not verify the accuracy of the text in the papers due to resource constraints

cases.claim: 呼吸科主题的论文编造参考文献的比例最高。
gold: For prompt B variations, the highest fabricated reference rates were in the fields of pulmonology (75%)
